Reuters' later refinery summaries tie independently sourced Syzran shutdown evidence to the 15 August strike, not clearly to 30 August. The conflicting evidence can still change repeat-event counts.

No Russian/regional/operator confirmation, independently verified fire imagery, or satellite target-effect evidence specific to the Engels node on that date was located. Earlier January and June Engels/Kristall strikes are distinct and cannot be inherited. The unresolved physical-effect status could change repeat-node logic.

Rostov governor reporting and multiple independent Russian outlets confirm a 50-square-metre fire at an industrial enterprise after the drone attack, but no source identifies the facility. Contemporary and later searches do not tie the 30 November fire to the Novoshakhtinsk refinery or another unique facility. TargetID, NodeID, sector and criticality therefore remain unresolved; exclusion or refinery assignment would both be unsupported.
